item.title: CVE-2026-129553 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Tensei through 0.11.5 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the @tensei/social-auth SocialAuthCallbackController that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users by supplying an unvalidated clientCallback query parameter. Attackers can craft links to the /:provider/callback route that send victims to attacker-controlled sites for phishing and leak the issued temporary access token appended after login.

item.title: CVE-2026-15707 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | An uncontrolled search path vulnerability (CWE-427) in statically linked OpenSSL libraries within Netskope Client (stAgentSvc.exe) and Endpoint DLP (epdlp.exe) on Windows allows an authenticated local attacker to execute arbitrary code with elevated SYSTEM privileges. The services retain internal build-time paths referencing a secondary drive location. On Windows systems where default volume permissions allow standard users to create root-level directories on secondary drives, an attacker can place a malicious configuration file (openssl.cnf) that is loaded under the NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM context upon service startup or system reboot. Under default operating system permissions, macOS and Linux are not susceptible, and mobile platforms are unaffected.
